note: FNS 754 is a QC variance exclusion rule within Chapter 7 'Review Procedures Relative to Certification Systems and Changes,' under 'OTHER INCLUDED AND EXCLUDED VARIANCES.' It instructs QC reviewers on when to exclude variances caused by inaccurate federal source data from error calculations — specifically, when the state agency 'appropriately acted on timely information.' This is QC audit methodology, not caseworker SNAP policy. The underlying caseworker duty (checking and acting on federal data sources) IS covered by the OLG through its External Agency Matches guidance (Matches Overview, PI Checklist, Match Disposition procedures), data source review requirements at application/recertification/IR (External Databases page), and verified-upon-receipt processing rules. The OLG requires workers to review all applicable data sources, process matches before authorization, and document sources reviewed in the case narrative. However, the variance exclusion framework and timeliness standard described in FNS 754 are QC concepts with no caseworker-facing equivalent.
